evidence_tree.command: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>
evidence_tree.isolation_note: Only data/ and docs/math-foundations.md from the export were read. src/, tests/, scripts/, docs/plans/, docs/receipts/ and git history were not consulted.

step_1_identify_castable_slots.reasoning: data/champion-audit/batch-6.json records Syndra's module slots as P, Q, Q2, W, E, R, where 'Q2' is a synthetic slot for the second Dark Sphere charge ('modeled = SLOTS keys incl. synthetic Q2 (2nd charge)') and P is a passive (cost: null in data/champions.json). The castable slots that can appear on a cast timeline are therefore Q, Q2, W, E, R.
step_1_identify_castable_slots.conclusion: cast_timeline[1] is the second cast of the derived slot order; with the passive excluded, the derived order begins Q, Q2, ...

step_2_scenario_suffix.reasoning: The '_60' suffix matches Syndra's splinter option value, which is the only 60-valued knob in her kit documentation: batch-6.json gap_summary states 'splinters option (0-120) gates Q2 second charge [40+], W 60-splinter true-damage (12%+2%/100 AP), P 120-splinter +15% AP buff'. At splinters = 60 the Q2 stocked-charge slot is unlocked (threshold 40) and the W true-damage bonus is active (threshold 60), but the 120 AP capstone is not.
step_2_scenario_suffix.conclusion: At splinters = 60 the timeline legitimately contains the Q2 (second Dark Sphere charge) cast.

step_3_cost_table.resource: MANA for Q, W, E, R (Syndra.resource = MANA); no Syndra ability in the cache has a zero or waived cost.

step_4_charge_cost_semantics.wiki_text_quoted: Q Dark Sphere, Transcendent Bonus: 'Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.'
step_4_charge_cost_semantics.reasoning: The cached effect text grants a stocked charge only - it says nothing about waiving the ability's resource cost, and Dark Sphere's cost block is a per-cast MANA cost (40/45/50/55/60). A stocked charge is an ammo mechanic (data/wiki-atoms/stack-transform-summon-resource.json, atom 'stack-transform-summon-resource.ammo': 'stocked ability casts (Ahri's Spirit Rush, Gangplank's Powder Keg, Syndra's Dark Sphere)'); ammo gates availability, it does not replace the mana cost, so each stocked Dark Sphere activation pays Dark Sphere's listed mana cost. Corroborating design evidence in the same cache: the passive exists to fund those extra casts - 'Collecting a Splinter of Wrath from an enemy restores 20 : 255 (based on level) mana.' A free second Q would make that mana-restore clause purposeless.
step_4_charge_cost_semantics.conclusion: resource_cost(Q2) = resource_cost(Q at the scenario's Q rank).

step_5_value.computation: Q rank 5 mana cost = 60 (cost.modifiers[0].values[4] = 60). Hence Q2 at max Q rank costs 60.0 mana.
step_5_value.robustness_check: The scenario's exact rank/level config is not visible from data/ alone, so I checked every candidate for cast_timeline[1] against the cached cost table: Q2 (or Q) at rank 5 = 60; W at rank 1 = 60; W at rank 5 = 100; E = 50 at all ranks; R = 100 at all ranks. 60.0 is exactly the value produced by the two plausible index-1 casts under the standard max-Q configuration (Q, then the Q2 stocked charge) or under an all-rank-1 configuration (Q, then W). No Syndra castable slot in the cache has cost 0, and no cached text waives a cost, so 0.0 is not reachable from source data.
step_5_value.free_recast_ruled_out: The only genuinely free Syndra activation is Force of Will's recast ('Force of Will can be recast while the target is being held. Recast: Syndra throws the grabbed target ...'), which shares the single W activation and its one 60/70/80/90/100 mana charge. The module carries no separate W-recast slot (batch-6.json slot list has W once, and a synthetic slot exists only for Q2), so no zero-cost W-throw entry can occupy cast_timeline[1].

Collecting a Splinter of Wrath from an enemy restores 20 : 255 (based on level) mana. Splinters of Wrath are brought to Syndra from enemies over 0.6 seconds.

cost [60, 70, 80, 90, 100]; 'Force of Will can be recast while the target is being held.' ; 'Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 60 Splinters of Wrath enhances Force of Will to deal 12% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage.'

modeled: [P, Q, Q2, W, E, R]; note: 'modeled = SLOTS keys incl. synthetic Q2 (2nd charge)'; gap_summary: 'splinters option (0-120) gates Q2 second charge, W 60-splinter true-damage (12%+2%/100 AP), P 120-splinter +15% AP buff'
A resource (internal index 12) consumed by specific actions ... stocked ability casts (Ahri's Spirit Rush, Gangplank's Powder Keg, Syndra's Dark Sphere)

Ability recasts are scheduled on one shared timeline (the champion has one set of hands): each cast occupies its sourced cast time ... and a cast counts when it starts within the window (`_schedule_shared_casts`).
sources.relevance: Confirms cast_timeline entries are individual scheduled casts; math-foundations contains no resource/mana formula, so the mana value must come from the cached cost table.

residual_uncertainty: The scenario's rank/level/option configuration lives in code that this investigation is forbidden to read, so the identity of cast_timeline[1] was inferred from the module slot order recorded in data/champion-audit/batch-6.json plus the '_60' splinter reading. That inference does not change the ruling: 0.0 is unreachable for any Syndra castable slot from cached source data, while 60.0 is exactly the cached Dark Sphere rank-5 mana cost (and equally the cached Force of Will rank-1 cost).
